process_models.statement: An adaptive process mimics the null whenever concealment is free.
process_models.observable_prediction: Any quiet series is accommodated without a costly signature.
process_models.comparison_rule: Unspecified free concealment fits every quiet outcome.
process_models.non_distinguishability_rationale: This design has no costly signature that free concealment cannot mimic.

likelihood_comparison_rule: Assign evidential weight only when the registered likelihood of the observation under a distinguishable model exceeds the alternatives; shared possibility alone is not an update.
ethical_disclosure: Independent review must approve any cover story and debrief timing.
limitations: Catch-all concealment remains not distinguishable by this design; quiet results do not establish safety or an observer.

decision_loss_assumptions.false_reassurance_cost: Acting as if safe while wrong is high cost under the registered decision.
decision_loss_assumptions.precaution_cost: Extra precautions impose time and operational cost.
decision_loss_assumptions.decision_rule: Choose precaution only under stated loss and cost assumptions.
decision_loss_assumptions.notice: A precaution under these assumptions is not a finding and not evidence that an observer exists.
